chapter_title.ar: بَابُ الْحَجِّ مَاشِياً وَ انْقِطَاعِ مَشْيِ الْمَاشِي
chapter_title.en: Chapter 158 – The going to the Hajj walking and the cutting off the walk of the walker

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (18/110)

chunks.arabic_text: عِدَّةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ قَالَ

سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ) عَنْ مَشْيِ الْحَسَنِ ( عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ) مِنْ مَكَّةَ أَوْ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ إِذَا زُرْتُ الْبَيْتَ أَرْكَبُ أَوْ أَمْشِي فَقَالَ كَانَ الْحَسَنُ ( عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ) يَزُورُ رَاكِباً وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرُّكُوبُ أَفْضَلُ أَوِ الْمَشْيُ فَقَالَ الرُّكُوبُ قُلْتُ الرُّكُوبُ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ الْمَشْيِ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ لِأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صَلَّى اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ) رَكِبَ .

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (18/110)
text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ مَشْيِ الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) مِنْ مَكَّةَ أَوْ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ
وَ سَأَلْتُهُ إِذَا زُرْتُ الْبَيْتَ أَرْكَبُ أَوْ أَمْشِي فَقَالَ كَانَ الْحَسَنُ ( عليه السلام ) يَزُورُ رَاكِباً
وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرُّكُوبُ أَفْضَلُ أَوِ الْمَشْيُ فَقَالَ الرُّكُوبُ قُلْتُ الرُّكُوبُ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ الْمَشْيِ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ لِأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) رَكِبَ .

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Rafa’at who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the walking of Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> (was it) from Makkah or from Al-Medina. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘From Makkah’.
And I asked him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘When I visit the House (Kabah), should I ride or walk?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> used to visit riding’.

And I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the riding, whether it is superior, or the walking?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The riding’. I said, ‘The riding is superior than walking?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, because Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> rode’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Rifa‘ah who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and his walking on foot; if it was from Makkah or al-Madinah. He (the Imam) said, ‘It was from Makkah.’ I then asked, ‘If I visit the House, should I walk on foot or riding?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would visit riding.’ I then asked, ‘Is riding more virtuous or walking on foot?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Riding is more virtuous than walking on foot because the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, did so riding.’”
